messages:
alex: heads-up — eu-west provision queue is spiking, ~18 racks showing OOB disconnects after last night's bmc push. GPUs draining from available pool.
priya: ugh, saw that. Any pattern on which SKUs or racks?
sam: same image/version across the fleet: fw-bmc-3.4.7 -> rolled at 02:10UTC. failures concentrated on racks with older BMC hw variant (rev B).
jin: logs look like repeated watchdog resets, then nvram write errors. possible RTC drift?
alex: exact symptoms: DUTs report IPMI lost, then re-register, and a subset come back with UEFI attributes flipped (Lockdown to Enabled). that triggers secureboot enforcement on some nodes and provisioning fails.
infra-oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-194, severity P2. Assigned: sam.
emily: can you paste the ipmitool output from a failing node?
sam: here —
```
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.46.3.21 -U admin -P **** sol info
SOL parameter got: Enabled
Last SOL message: watchdog expire: kernel panic
ipmi message: NVRAM write error: crc_mismatch
BMC RTC: 1970-01-01 00:00:03
UEFI Var: SecureBoot=1 -> toggled
```

priya: RTC at 1970 means clock cleared at boot -> nvram CRC mismatch plausible. Firmware init path is zeroing RTC and rewriting vars, which can flip UEFI attr if write ordering races.
alex: consequence: deploy agent fails on nodes with SecureBoot enforced. they show up as "reprovision required" in the fleet API, not available for GPU scheduling.
nate: how many GPUs offline?
sam: preliminary: ~432 GPUs offline across 18 racks (A100 + H100 mix). capacity loss ~12% in eu-west.
priya: long tail in the queue — customers on reserved capacity affected. cost and SLA risk. need mitigation plan ASAP.
jin: short-term mitigation options: 1) blackhole affected racks from scheduler so allocations don't retry; 2) temporarily disable secureboot enforcement during reprovisioning (if safe); 3) roll back BMC firmware to 3.4.6 on rev B hardware.
emily: disabling secureboot enforcement is risky for multi-tenant — ops/security approval needed.
alex: security ok to allow temporary exception for reprovision-only if we pin images and scope to dedicated racks (no shared tenants). i'll loop in sec.
priya: can we auto-retry the NVRAM write with a staggered delay? I can push a targeted script to attempt reapply of UEFI vars after RTC correction.
sam: sharing the quick reapply snippet i used on a lab node:
```
# fix-uefi-vars.sh (run as root)
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P $PASS raw 0x3a 0x04 0x01  # dummy rtc set
sleep 2
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P $PASS raw 0x3a 0x05  # trigger nvram rewrite
sleep 5
# re-check
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P $PASS sel elist | tail -n 5
```

jin: that worked in lab for 3 of 4 nodes, last one needed power-cycle.
infra-oncall-bot: scheduled rollback job: roll-bmc-fw-3.4.6 -> targeting rev B racks only. start ETA 22:30UTC.
alex: action items:
- sam: run targeted reapply script on the 18 racks now (in batches of 4).
- priya: coordinate sec approval for reprovision exception window and add audit logs.
- jin: prepare rollback job and test on 2 canary racks.
- emily: notify customer ops for impacted reserved customers and suggest temporary capacity re-route.
- nate: adjust autoscaling to try spin-up in eu-central for burst traffic and flag cost delta.

emily: estimated hit if we shift 12% load to eu-central: ~$8k/day extra (spot + egress). ops ok?
alex: finance/ops — keep this as soft estimate, we'll update after canary.
priya: update: sec approved reprovision-only exception for 60m window with mandatory logging and pinning.
sam: running batch 1 now (racks 3-6). progress logs: 3/4 nodes reapply ok, 1 pending power-cycle.
jin: canary rollback queued, waiting for power window.
alex: thanks team. keep thread updated with timestamps. i'll update runbook after we confirm root cause (nvram ordering + rtc init).
emily: customer comms draft in #customer-success ready to go, lmk edits.
infra-oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-194 updated: mitigation in progress.
sam: batch 2 complete, overall 14 racks recovered so far. 4 need manual power-cycle and kernel re-install.
priya: creating follow-up ticket to audit fw images on rev B hardware and add an early RTC check in the firmware init smoke tests.
alex: closing loop — long-term: require RTC persistence test in preflight and treat nvram CRC mismatch as preflight fail. scheduling a postmortem for tomorrow 14:00UTC. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
